Decide the comparison explicitly: for redundant re-sort removal, feed the same already sorted pack to both arms; for upstream preparation amortization, report preparation separately and include it in the stated end-to-end/amortized result. Do not compare sorting reverse input against a falsely tagged reverse input.
Emit workload shape, output digest/count, preparation policy and measured completed operations. Fail or mark incomparable if output differs.

Include realistic presorted and shuffled shapes and larger sizes; use warmup/repeated sufficiently long samples, not only the default five renders of 2,000 nodes. Report preparation and rendering costs separately rather than inferring an application speedup.
Qualify the requested resource/work or latency evidence with meaningful inputs; run actual measurements serially and retain raw samples.
Pass the related existing checks and the complete original/follow-up acceptance on the resulting candidate; preserve positive and negative controls.

issues.title: [P3] Exercise distinct artifact admission and isolate cache phases in the graph lazy-load benchmark
remaining: Define a real comparison for the same downstream task: e.g. eager load-all versus selecting only a required artifact family, using fixtures with substantial omitted families. Do not just relabel two equivalent selections. If the desired optimization is intra-graph-family projection, measure it only after that boundary actually exists.

Separate cold admission/build from warm index hits. Isolate application caches with fresh workers/processes (creating a new store alone does not necessarily clear module-level caches), or an explicit owned test reset; retain identical OS-cache policy and balanced arm order.

Assert expected artifact reads/bytes, index-build counts, cache misses/hits and semantic result parity before qualifying a delta. Emit those facts with each arm. Mark the lazy comparison unavailable when the fixture contains no meaningful omitted work.

Vary total relation nodes/edges, call-site occurrences and symbol-edge bytes independently. Include both small contract cases and substantial skewed omitted-family cases. Run sustained/repeated timing samples and report cold distributions separately from warm distributions; retain manifest/integrity admission costs rather than bypassing them.

issues.title: [P3] Separate cold materialization, persisted-cache admission and hot reuse in VFS benchmarks
remaining: Define separate measured scenarios: fresh document materialization, fresh-process persisted-cache admission/reuse, and steady in-process hits. Recreate/reset only an exclusively owned fixture for each intended cold repetition; never delete a caller's unowned directory.

Report cache-load, document-access/materialization and flush phases separately, plus a clearly specified total. If comparing end-to-end restart benefit, include the persisted-cache load in that total and keep equivalent persistence obligations. A hot-access-only measurement may remain, but label it as such.

Count actual created/reused documents, persisted/in-memory hit sources, loaded entries/bytes and flushes per sample. Refuse or mark a claimed warm/cold scenario unqualified when observed phases differ; do not infer mode from its argument alone.

Controlled adapters prove that sample-count changes do not turn cold repetitions into hot ones, and that the warm process really consumes a persisted cache. Include missing/stale/corrupt cache cases as explicit misses, not warm success.

issues.title: [P3] Measure comparable publication costs and truthful memory maxima in map benchmarks
remaining: build-map-streaming measure calls process.memoryUsage() only immediately before and after the awaited writer, then names the maximum peakHeap/peakRss. Temporary strings/buffers allocated and collected between those points are unobserved. A transient allocation that returns to the same endpoint footprint leaves the reported metric unchanged.

Keep cheap stage snapshots, but name them accurately (observedBoundaryMax..., sample policy/coverage). Do not relabel RSS delta as peak. For actual peak qualification use isolated per-arm processes and an explicitly described high-water/sampling mechanism; process-lifetime RSS must be scoped to a fresh child or clearly distinguished from phase-only memory. A same-event-loop interval cannot observe a synchronous JSON.stringify peak, so do not present that alone as a fix.

Compare like publication semantics: both arms use the same atomic owner, or split encoding/streaming, write and atomic-publication phases and report the distinct end-to-end contracts explicitly. Preserve the production stream's atomic guarantees rather than disabling them to obtain a favorable number.
Add a final build memory observation after sorting/hashing/assembly and preserve the distinction between sampled observations and a true measured maximum.
Qualify the requested resource/work or latency evidence with meaningful inputs; run actual measurements serially and retain raw samples.
